name: Stained-Glass Church
text: If you own sigils of six or more colors, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: scoring, six or more resonances owned

decision: Shopping: chase a sixth resonance through splashes and signposts, even at the cost of a stronger card in your main colors.
opponent: Visible when it triggers; opponents can hold their ace to capture the king.
aiNote: Value any sigil of a new resonance highly once you own four or five.
rationale: Owning six resonances takes most of a run and costs focus in the main archetype, so it arrives late and applies win or lose, about +50 a round once met; six stays well above Artist's Palette's three.
deviation: Removed the king affinity and win trigger, so the condition is the whole design.
